attackers_goals: An attacker's goal is to gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or perform malicious actions on behalf of the impersonated user.
description: A user has initiated a session impersonation in Okta.
detection_modules: Identity Threat Module, SaaS Threat Detection
investigative_actions: Ensure the user is authorized to impersonate a user session. Review any activities that occurred during the impersonation session. Look for any activities related to the impersonated user's account during and after the impersonation event.
name: Okta User Session Impersonation
